notes: Ledger is seeded with P0 content gaps (scenes marked not-built in scene-manifest.json): the bridge records evidence, it never fabricates evidence for content that does not exist.
Accepted vision-model reviews are appended under reviews and their unique defect ids are added under defects.
Severity: P0 = blocker (frame is unusable evidence or content missing), P1 = clearly visible commercial-quality failure, P2 = polish issue.
